summary: Public Service Company of Colorado filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of First Mortgage Bonds, including a reopening of its 5.35% Series No. 41 due 2034 and a new Series No. 47 due later. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The bonds are senior secured obligations, issued in $2,000 denominations, with no exchange listing. There are no strategic, M&A, or restructuring elements; the sole purpose is raising debt capital. Proceeds, underwriting discounts, and final pricing remain subject to completion. This is an ordinary shelf takedown with no special-situation characteristics.
